verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own feature asks the team questions on a recurring schedule, such as every Monday at 9am, and collects the answers. That is a product-native recurring automation for routine team work, but it is one fixed-purpose feature, not a general workflow builder. Templates are reusable structure, not scheduled runs, and the REST API is only a building block, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: a general-purpose workflow or automation builder, custom actions beyond scheduled questions, event-based triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Basecamp asks your team questions on a schedule, like “What are you working on this week?” every Monday at 9am, and saves everyone’s answers in one place.
